mc.reason: The core-mod namespace named in ADR-0003. Reserved so that no individual account can ever claim the platform's own core namespace by registering the GitHub username "mc" (ADR-0119 Section 1).

test.reason: Mission SITE-V1 publishes test:hello-world as the permanent pipeline canary. Reserved because the ordinary username-derived namespace rule would otherwise force registry CI to reject it, since "test" is not the publisher's own username (ADR-0119 Context and Section 1).
